title: Request for opinions.
author: loontoon
selftext:
Would you play a game where the character you control is a ball, or would you prefer to be controlling a little animated man/woman?  

Thanks!

comments.author: Roenbaeck
comments.body: Well, I loved Marble Madness at the time, so I guess a ball is fine in the right type of game.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
Thank you.   
  
My game started life as a simple mobile game where you'd tilt your phone or tablet to guide a ball through a series of mazes and puzzles. 

It then morphed into a 3D game based around exploration, puzzles and elements of Rube Goldberg type setups / machines. 

Creating an animated character is frankly a bit beyond my capabilites, so you still control a ball and activate switches, pick objects up, place object etc by simply rolling into or over them.    
  
On mobile devices it has tilt controls as well as touch controls and on desktop/laptop it has mouse and keyboard controls. I will be adding controller support as well. 

My back story explains why you are a ball - and I think the back story is quite fun and will be featured in the game, not just in the game description.

comments.author: Cubey42
comments.body: I feel like the vision for the game should answer that question for you. It's not really like a consensus answer much thing. Wouldn't make sense to be a ball in a driving sim, but works quite well in super monkey ball

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body:
I've never seen or played Super Monkey Ball, but I know what you are saying.  

Thanks!

comments.author: LatoGamesStudio
comments.body: It depends a lot on the type of game, if rolling around and bouncing off things feels satisfying, then that works perfectly for me!

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: Thanks! I'm trying to get things in a state where I can show what I'm working on.

comments.author: Familiar-Way-7913
comments.body: If your gameplay is fun there is no problem I control ball or human.

comments.author: Antonidiuss
comments.body: You can put a human in a ball and do gameplay around it)

comments.author: everyoneLikesPizza
comments.body: Impossible to answer with zero visuals or context. Get some people to playtest and ask them. And if you don’t have any gameplay yet do that first.

replies.author: loontoon
replies.body: Hopefully soon, although I'm still a long way off because I'm no good at graphic design.

replies.author: everyoneLikesPizza
replies.body: You only need very basic graphics to playtest like literally a circle. Gameplay first
